row.name: lofiii
row.description: Experience the chill vibes of Lo-Fi music with LoFIII, an open source #Flutter app designed for Lo-Fi enthusiasts. Built with #BLoC architecture, Get It for easy management of dependencies, REST API for a vast music library, and #Hive for storing your personal collection. Tune in, relax, and enjoy!  (LOFIII is Under Development)
